summary:
Implemented rich_measure for Tree and VerticalCenter in the generated repo, without running tests or committing. Changes: rich/tree.py adds Tree.__rich_measure__ (iterative DFS with explicit stack, level counter, 4-cell indent), plus a new import of Measurement from .measure, which the spec's no-new-imports rule does not allow. rich/align.py adds Align.__repr__, Align width constraint to measured maximum (min with explicit width), and a public VerticalCenter class (render with newline padding from console.size.height, measurement delegation, repr). rich/console.py sets justify="default" in print's render options. CHANGELOG.md marks 9.8.0 as UNRELEASED with an Added section, keeping the existing bullet first. Tests added in tests/test_align.py (repr, VerticalCenter render expecting "

foo


", measurement 3/3) and tests/test_tree.py (measurement 11/19); existing test_render unchanged. All unverified since tests were not run.
